sections.heading: Value copies and identity boundaries
sections.markdown: `const` fixes the binding and its value-semantic components. Saving a copyable Array into another binding preserves a logical copy; it does not require explicit copy/move or unique backing. Class and synchronized fields retain identity, so const does not freeze their referenced objects or prove Sendable. Type-position `const T` is outside this frozen subset. Spec §17.26 admits ordinary Array copies and independent mutation of a writable local copy. The broader identity/resource cases in the example remain language contracts and do not imply complete new-XIR qualification.
